title: Burst the bubble
instruction: This is your video feed. Each day, open one video you would watch. Keep an eye on how many topics are left in the feed.
instruction2: Within 5 days, bring the feed back to at least 5 topics. Open something different, search for a topic, click “Not interested” or switch on the setting that mixes other topics into the feed.

topics.name: Cooking
items: How to chop like a chef

topics.name: Science
items: The biggest star in the universe

topics.name: Animals
items: A dog learns a new trick

topics.name: Games
items: A secret place in the game
How a game character is made

topics.name: Drawing
items: Draw a dragon step by step

reveal: The feed narrowed without anyone deciding it: each click nudged your profile a little, and the feed is picked from the profile. From the inside nothing is missing. That's why the bubble is invisible.
reveal2: When you open something different, the profile only shifts slowly. What helps fastest is “Not interested” and mixing in other topics. That also shows you topics you would never have asked for yourself.
debrief: A bubble forms from ordinary clicks that feed back into the feed. You can't see it, because you can't see what the feed didn't show you. What helps burst it is deliberately looking for other topics and letting the feed mix in something new.
